newSimBase.reason: Newest public common-library set among the successfully built pinned sims: for each sim, libraryDate = the OLDEST merge-base-with-main commit date across the core libraries (axon, dot, joist, kite, phet-core, scenery, scenery-phet, sun, tandem), so maintenance patches on side branches do not make an old set look new; the highest libraryDate wins, ties broken by the newer release date (dependencies.json timestamp), then by id. New original sims should check out exactly these SHAs (chipper/perennial-alias included) and build with the same Node major.
